subject: infra.store
name: Trans-Sahara and Tatweer Tripoli data centre
what_would_settle_it: Any statement, contract, opening report or capacity figure after 2019 establishing whether the Huawei FusionModule1000A facility announced for Tripoli in early 2020 was ever deployed.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the probe returned only the same two 2019 accounts. A separate Misrata Free Zone data centre (Libya Herald, 2023-02) surfaced and is a different object, raised as an acquisition line.

subject: infra.capacity
name: National data-centre capacity
what_would_settle_it: A published figure for installed or contracted data-centre capacity in Libya, from an operator, GACI or a colocation provider.
disposition: absence stands, dated — only paid market reports and two vendor pages (Sadeem, LTT Internet Data Center); no operator or regulator figure is published.

subject: infra.energy
name: Power supply to networks and data centres
what_would_settle_it: An operator, GECOL or GACI statement quantifying outage exposure or backup provision for telecommunications sites and data centres.
disposition: absence stands, dated — outage incidents are reported (a 2025 station failure, a 2020 committee on power to bank data centres) but no provision or exposure figure is published.

subject: digital.rural
name: Rural digital service programme
what_would_settle_it: A named programme, budget line or coverage obligation addressing digital services outside the coastal cities, from GACI, the Ministry of Local Government or an operator.
disposition: absence stands, dated — a GACI 5G roadmap review mentions extending coverage to remote areas; no named rural programme, obligation or budget line is published.

subject: data.open
name: Access-to-information statute
what_would_settle_it: A gazetted Libyan access-to-information law or decree, or an official statement that none is in force.
disposition: absence stands, dated — no access-to-information statute found. Law No. 4 of 1990 on the national information and documentation system is the nearest instrument and governs secrecy rather than access; raised as an acquisition line.

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital-literacy programme
what_would_settle_it: A named national digital-literacy or digital-skills programme with enrolment or completion figures, from the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Labour or GACI.
disposition: found — Expertise France's Raqameyon and Raqam-e, the EU4Skills project and the EU/UNDP Mahara school, all with figures; donor-run rather than national, and raised as acquisition lines.

subject: finance.budget
name: Public budget allocation to digital government
what_would_settle_it: A Libyan budget or expenditure statement carrying an identifiable appropriation for communications, informatics or digital transformation.
disposition: found — the Central Bank's revenue and expenditure statements carry a line for the General Authority for Communications and Informatics and its affiliates, and a unified 190bn dinar state budget was adopted 2026-04-11; both raised as acquisition lines.
